name: first-run-setup-wizard
description: A first launch with no LLM provider opens the setup wizard on its own (the same screen /setup opens), Esc leaves it, and the launch is remembered. Runs with an empty HOME, the hub off and the environment cleared (so no provider key auto-activates a profile), so it never touches the real ~/.kollab or a live daemon.

config.command: bash -lc 'source .venv/bin/activate 2>/dev/null; exec env -i HOME=/tmp/kollab-first-run-wizard PATH="$PATH" TERM="$TERM" LANG=en_US.UTF-8 KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 python main.py --no-daemon'

steps.title: Esc leaves it and the launch is remembered

steps.description: setup_completed saved, so the next launch does not nag
